strategyPosture: Hold the risk-tolerant posture credit grants, but treat all new exposure as staged probing into the DATA_AHEAD dislocation clusters (nuclear/power, software troughs) — nothing full-size ahead of Wednesday's PCE, which can reprice the whole permission structure in one print.

themes.counterRead: The divergence is real but credit conditions don't confirm a broad rollover — tight spreads and loose lending standards historically say rotation, not capitulation. Positioning should treat weakness as concentrated, not systemic: no de-risking signal yet, but don't mistake SPY's price for breadth health. NFLX and UBER's presence in the laggard list means the rotation is already biting the portfolio.
themes.dataAnchor: The Mag7 averages 11.44% below 52-week highs — a 9.64-point divergence gap vs SPY. TSLA is 28.3% off its high while AAPL is only 2% off. IWM is down 6.36% over the month and 6.08% over 3 months — small caps are in an outright downtrend the index hides. The marketConcentration.readState is ROTATION_NOT_ROLLOVER: index-leadership rotation, with bank lending standards LOOSE (SLOOS 0%) and HY OAS tight at 2.93. Two portfolio holdings, NFLX (-12.45% 1m) and UBER (-11.13% 1m), sit in the laggard cohort.
themes.label: Index calm masks concentrated damage
themes.narrative: SPY sits just 1.8% off its 52-week high and the index reads calm, implying the broad market is healthy.
themes.watchFor: Divergence gap closes below 5 points (breadth heals) or HY OAS pushes above 4.0 (rotation becomes rollover).

themes.counterRead: Price is pricing a demand collapse that revenue and insider behavior don't show. This is the dislocation list's deepest cluster with the strongest recovery signals — but VST's revenueInflection reads DETERIORATING in one leg, so this is a staged-probe zone, not a blanket buy. The oversold RSI on BWXT marks exhaustion, not confirmation.
themes.dataAnchor: BWXT is 44.4% below its 52-week high with RSI-14 at 29.7 (oversold) while revenue is growing 26.1% YoY — recovery confirmed in the pipeline's own terms. VST, a portfolio holding, is 36.4% off its high at $138.02 with insiders buying $1.17M at the trough and revenue growing 19.1% YoY. The pipeline's top conviction tier scores these names 76-78. Decline reasons across the complex read SENTIMENT_DRIVEN, not fundamentals-driven.
themes.label: Nuclear / AI power complex washed out
themes.narrative: The AI-power trade is being sold as over: URA -16.89%, CCJ -17.08%, SMR -17.66% in one month, with SMR down 4.76% today alone. The tape says the nuclear thesis is broken.
themes.watchFor: BWXT RSI-14 reclaiming 40 or VST closing back within 25% of its 52-week high on volume.

themes.counterRead: Fundamentals are recovering while prices still price distress — classic DATA_AHEAD geometry. The gap is widest where decline reasons read SENTIMENT_DRIVEN across every name in the cluster. The risk is time: revenue recovery is confirmed but price confirmation hasn't arrived, so sizing should follow staged entries rather than full conviction at once.
themes.dataAnchor: NOW is 31.9% below its high at $131.45 with revenue growing 23.1% YoY — revenueInflection RECOVERY. APP is 58.7% off its high with revenue growing 55.8% YoY and a 76% gross margin. NXT is 51.5% off its high with revenue +31.6% YoY. These three carry watchlist promotion scores of 70-72 on durable-moat-at-trough logic.
themes.label: Enterprise software troughs against growing revenue
themes.narrative: Software is priced for a demand winter: TTD is 78.1% off its high, HUBS 61.3%, APP 58.7%, NXT 51.5%. The market is treating the cohort as structurally impaired.
themes.watchFor: Any of NOW/APP/NXT posting a positive 1-month trend reversal confirmed by a second leg up.

themes.counterRead: A 26% monthly vertical ending with a 4% down day is distribution-shaped, not accumulation-shaped. The narrative is extrapolating one name's sprint plus crypto beta into broad risk-on, while IWM bleeds and the Mag7 diverges. For a holding, this is trim-on-strength geometry, not add-on-breakout.
themes.dataAnchor: META's one-month sprint is the single largest leader gain in the snapshot, but it closed down 3.99% today — the biggest single-day drop among the leaders. META is a portfolio holding, so this sprint is live P&L. The leaders board is dominated by the crypto complex (ETH-USD, BTC-USD, IBIT all top-6), which is reflexivity, not breadth.
themes.label: The one vertical that worked
themes.narrative: META's +26.37% month and the crypto complex (ETH +9.3%, BTC +7.07%) are being read as proof risk appetite is fully back — the market is chasing the winners.
themes.watchFor: META giving back more than half the 1-month gain, or ETH/BTC rolling over together with META — correlation of the sprint complex.

themes.counterRead: Narrative and data agree enough to hold the current read: credit is the permission slip for staying exposed, and it is firmly granted. The VIX at 16.03 (+7.44% 1m) is the only cross-current — a slow fear bid building under tight spreads. The regime stays risk-tolerant until credit, not rates, flinches.
themes.dataAnchor: HY OAS sits at 2.93 — tight, nowhere near stress. Bank lending standards are LOOSE (SLOOS 0%, far below the ~40% stress threshold). The 2s10s curve is +0.43 (positively sloped), the 10-year breakeven is 2.34 and real 10-year is 2.90. DFF is 3.88. Credit markets are not pricing any of the stress the rate level implies.
themes.label: Credit says permission, rates say watch the curve
themes.narrative: The 10-year at 5.24% and the 2-year at 4.81% imply rates are restrictive enough to eventually break something.
themes.watchFor: HY OAS breaking 4.0 or SLOOS lifting above 20% — either revokes the macro permission slip.

watchFor: HY OAS above 4.0 — credit stress, rotation becomes rollover, cut risk
SLOOS above 20% — lending standards tightening, revoke macro permission
Mag7-vs-SPY divergence gap below 5 points — breadth healing confirmed
BWXT RSI-14 back above 40 — nuclear/power capitulation reversal starting
META surrendering more than half its +26.37% 1-month gain — sprint complex rolls over
whereWaveBuilds: The next leg most likely materializes as a capitulation reversal in the nuclear/power complex — BWXT at RSI 29.7 with 26.1% revenue growth and VST insiders buying $1.17M at the trough are the exhaustion markers — triggered by the divergence gap between Mag7 and SPY starting to close as rotation broadens past the mega-caps.
